info.name: Editor Chooser
info.summary: Choose between OnlyOffice and Collabora when opening documents
info.description: Adds an "Open with…" file action to Nextcloud Files that lets users choose between OnlyOffice and Collabora Online. Monitors the OnlyOffice Community Edition connection limit (20) and offers read-only mode or Collabora as fallback when the limit is reached.
info.author: jakobkrieger
